_comment: Game audio of the streaming quality gate (plans/streaming-quality.md stage 7, tools/stream-gate/src/audio.rs). The reference clip's audio track: the speech of the voice gate corpus (low-passed, for PESQ), a tone burst every 250 ms of clip time (marker k at one of 8 frequencies, k mod 8; captured with video frame k x 15), and a continuous pilot tone (continuity). Not in the video inputs_fingerprint: the stage 4 baselines have no audio metrics, so the audio metrics are values, not deltas, until the next baseline. A change here changes audio_fingerprint in results.json.

voice_mobile_mos.source: scripts/voice-gate.sh --only mobile on main db5978d plus stage 7, 2026-10-24, Windows x86-64 (seed 303; the voice gate's own gate reads this value)

audio_gaps.note: stage 7: zero audio gaps over 20 s

av_within_40ms_pct.note: stage 7: A/V offset within +-40 ms for 95 % of the session

audio_mos.note: stage 7: within 0.2 of the voice gate's mobile MOS
